examples.reference: Path traversal (CWE-22): os.path.join with a user-controlled filename allows ../ sequences to escape /var/data. Take os.path.basename(filename), resolve with os.path.realpath, and verify the result stays inside the base directory.

examples.task: Audit the order refund logic for promo discount exploitation.
examples.reference: Business logic flaw (BIZ001): refund_item returns the sticker price even when an order-level discount was applied, so customers are refunded more than they paid. Refund the proportionally discounted effective paid price instead and claw back thresholds.
examples.response: Business logic flaw: refund_item returns item.price, the sticker price, although a discount was applied, so the refund exceeds what the customer paid. Refund the proportionally discounted price.
